scientific_integrity: Proof gives exact finite correspondence count and mathematical limiting laws; exhaustive verification over 21,845 small profiles supports finite reductions but is not evidence of the asymptotic claims. Publication priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: Two labeled equally weighted agents, independent homogeneous binary approvals, and distinct minimally complete non-redundant optimal allocations before tie-breaking; no result for heterogeneous correlations, deterministic tie-break output, or more agents. Entropy convergence is in distribution, without an asserted moment limit.
title: A cube-root transition in the multiplicity of binary Nash-welfare allocations
